subject: dsa
title: Reverse Nodes in K-Group
summary: Reverse a linked list in groups of k nodes.
problem: Reverse the nodes of a linked list k at a time and return the modified list. If the number of nodes is not a multiple of k, the leftover tail shorter than k is left as is. Here the list is 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5 with k = 2.

steps.caption: Reverse every k=2 nodes. A leftover tail shorter than k is left alone.
Reverse the first group of 2 to get 2 -> 1, then link 1 to the next group's head 3.
Reverse the second group of 2 to get 4 -> 3, then link it into place. Order is now 2 -> 1 -> 4 -> 3 -> 5.
The last node 5 is a group of 1, which is shorter than k, so it stays in place.
